release_read.basis: The thesis line fails: Q3 ASP rose only 2% to $4.12/kg, still below the $4.23/kg cash cost, and the CEO says pricing lagged the market recovery; loss per ADS $0.78 against Nasdaq's single ($0.21) forecast, Q4 production guide 35-45k MT soft with a utilization cut under evaluation. Offsets: revenue $194M on 46,910 MT sold, EBITDA near breakeven (-$9.2M), cash up to $2.06B on a stock at its 52-week low.

bar here is the thesis: ASP at or above cash cost ($4.23/kg); it stayed below

key_line.detail: ASP $4.12/kg, +2.0% q/q, below the $4.23/kg cash cost; CEO: 'the increase lagged the broader market recovery'. Sales volume 46,910 MT vs 15,190 MT; inventory impairment $30.9M (third straight).

guidance.detail: Q4 production 35,000-45,000 MT (below Q3's 53,469 MT) and 'evaluating a reduction in our near-term utilization rate'; FY2026 production raised to 175,000-185,000 MT from 160,000-180,000 MT (a mechanical consequence of Q3). No price guide.

call.detail: Call held 08:00 ET; a Benzinga transcript exists but returned 403, so tone and Q&A were not read. No session-time call risk remains.

public_reaction.summary: Headlines split: 'Q3 Revenue Beats Big, Loss Wider Than Expected' (Chartmill), 'Q3 revenue jumps on higher polysilicon sales volume' (rallies.ai), 'Q3 Revenue Down YoY to $194M' (StockTitan). No analyst actions searched within the time budget. All snippet_only.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 10.30 = +1.88% vs 10.11 close, against a frozen read of -2.5% and an implied move of 12.2%. Very thin and stale: 6 prints, none in the last 30 minutes, last at 08:38 (before the 08:00 call could be digested fully), stale_at_open true. Market mildly up (IWM +0.4%). The position is +2.2% vs its 10.08 entry.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was a realised ASP at or above cash cost after a 30%+ spot rebound; ASP rose only 2% and stayed below cash cost, management says it lagged the market, a third inventory impairment landed and Q4 output is guided lower. Volume and cash are the only lines that help.

expected.open_lag_note: The pre-market is six prints with the last at 08:38, so the open is as likely to miss the +1.9% as to hold it; the release reads negative on the thesis line and the EPS, and a bmo name with a contradicted thesis tends to keep repricing down through the session.

recommendation.reason: De kern van de koop klopt niet: de verkoopprijs van polysilicium steeg maar 2% en bleef onder de kostprijs, het verlies was veel groter dan verwacht en de productie voor Q4 gaat omlaag. De koers staat voorbeurs licht hoger (+1,9%) en de positie staat op winst; verkoop bij de opening in plaats van tot 13:00 te wachten, want de dag kan dit nog teruggeven.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als er voor 09:30 actieve voorbeurshandel komt met een koers duidelijk boven 10,50 of een koersdoelverhoging van een analist, dan is wachten tot 13:00 (de standaardregel) beter.
